Payments Product Owner

We are a fast-growing fintech company building payment products for shops
and banks. Our product teams own their features end to end, from the first
idea to the moment merchants use them every day.

Responsibilities:
- Work in teams with designers and engineers to ship payment features
- Make decisions quickly when trade-offs appear
- Manage stakeholders across the company and keep everyone aligned

Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience in payments or banking products
- Excellent communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:
- You comply with regulations for payment services and data protection

What we offer: a modern office, a learning budget and real ownership.
